scope: one bundled release helper, one new empty Vela store, no schedule, default watcher enabled; no GUI

startup.measurement: monotonic elapsed from Popen invocation to first system.version JSON-RPC response

idle.rssUnit: KiB resident set size reported by ps
idle.cpuUnit: percent reported by ps; platform-provided process percentage, not a dedicated interval CPU profiler

finding: This single run observed startup activity through 15 seconds (CPU samples up to 17.5% and RSS up to 92,912 KiB); later samples were 0.1–0.2% CPU. It is evidence of this run, not an idle-budget pass.
notRun: synthetic five-writer burst (not representative of five real provider loads)
limits: One empty-store helper sample is not a cold-start distribution or a five-Agent workload.
No synthetic event burst was run: it would not establish five real provider load or event-to-UI latency.
This measurement does not change HG-1 Performance status or infer package performance from package size.
